title: info-geometry-lean: Information Geometry of Quantum Gravity — Lean 4 and SymPy Formalization
description: Lean 4 and SymPy formalization project for the information geometry of quantum gravity, featuring a maintained representation-depth theorem spine spanning projective geometry (PGA), operator algebras, and thermodynamic inference. The repository identifies a stable core centered on modular and spectral operator theory, Krein-Clifford doubled geometry, and Drazin/inverse-kernel anomaly analysis with Einstein-source bridges. Recent architectural extensions formalize the holographic boundary of Conformal Cyclic Cosmology (CCC) via Cuntz-Toeplitz noncommutative quasicrystals (Penrose tilings), where matter-field sockets are modeled by Golden Ratio q-deformed Canonical Commutation Relations (q-CCR). The framework links the E_{7(7)} Freudenthal black-hole entropy invariant to scalar microscopic entropy anchors on the fractal boundary. The master theorem compile : ChiralTripleSystem → SpacetimeGeometry establishes the 5-graded Tits-Kantor-Koecher closure as the generative mechanism for the Minkowski metric. Contains 376 Lean 4 modules and 329 SymPy verification scripts.
